Frozen evidence from this run; extracted values below, original bytes attached inside the draft PDF.
Accrual. Contract revenue by the percentage-of-completion method for books and tax, as in prior years.
Fiscal year ending June 30. This return is for July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.
Celeste Whitford 60% and Riley Tanaka 40%, both U.S. individuals. No change in the year.

President and CEO Celeste Whitford: salary $395,000.00. Chief Financial Officer Jordan Hale: salary $310,000.00. Vice President Riley Tanaka is not an employee and was paid nothing. The board resolution approving FY2026 officer pay was prepared and has not been signed.
Related companies and transactions with owners

Juniper Ridge Partners LLC is owned by our Vice President. We are building its business park (job J-2625) under a cost-plus contract; pay application 1, $277,875.00, was billed June 30, 2026 and paid July 20, 2026. No loans to or from shareholders.
Fines or penalties paid to a government
Yes. A $6,800.00 Labor and Industries citation penalty (fall protection, Alder Point Medical Pavilion), in account 6500.
Business meals on the corporate card, $41,860.00, and arena suite tickets for owners’ representatives, $6,400.00, with no meal. Both in account 6500.
Two cash gifts to section 501(c)(3) organizations, $5,000.00 in all, each acknowledged in writing. No carryover from FY2025.

Seven additions. The 30-ton excavator (EQ-4410) was ordered under a purchase contract signed December 2, 2024 and delivered August 14, 2025. The 2005 crawler crane (EQ-2740) was sold March 16, 2026 for $180,000.00; the proceeds were credited to accumulated depreciation. Two 2008 office trailers were scrapped. No election out of the special allowance and no section 179 election.

No FY2026 estimated payments were made: the board deferred them while the line of credit was drawn, expecting the FY2025 loss to cover the year. Form 7004 was filed September 15, 2026 with a $15,000.00 payment.
Four quarterly dividends of $90,000.00 declared by the board and paid September 30 and December 31, 2025 and March 31 and June 30, 2026; 60% and 40%. Forms 1099-DIV issued for each calendar year.
FY2025 ended with a $2,904,180.00 net operating loss on the return as filed, carried forward.

The warranty reserve on completed jobs was $118,000.00 at June 30, 2025 and $125,000.00 at June 30, 2026; warranty work is charged to other job costs (5500) when done. The other June 30 accruals were paid by mid-September.
